decisions.title: Agent-initiated decision intake and ADR triage
decisions.statement: 讨论中形成的长期决定需要由 Agent 主动捕获、留痕并在正确检查点发起 ADR 或需求确认，而不是等待用户记得要求写 ADR。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Use an append-only Decision Inbox for durable discussion decisions; Agent-owned triage classifies each decision and proposes a new ADR when architecture conditions apply. ADRs may exist without a REQ when they retain an originating DEC.

triage.rationale: The rule changes the cross-cutting governance contract and requires implementation of registries, gates and tests.

decisions.title: Explicit unreviewed approval and 0.6.0 first-wave authorization
decisions.statement: 增加“批准，但未仔细查阅”的状态，并据此批准版本重排和第一批开发。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Add approved_unreviewed design status with a mandatory approval note; authorize REQ-HOST-002 and REQ-ACTION-001 for the first 0.6.0 implementation wave while leaving later requirements frozen.

triage.rationale: The approval state changes the cross-cutting governance contract and requires implementation and tests.

decisions.title: Harden Action results approvals and observability
decisions.statement: 先继续 0.6 硬化：补 ActionResult 元数据、Action Manager、审批票据、二进制输出、幂等和迟到结果测试。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Treat Action result metadata and approval receipts as durable first-class data; expose an Action manager; preserve binary artifacts; prevent duplicate side effects for providers that require idempotency; and never accept late remote results as success.

triage.rationale: The change affects execution trust, persistence and every Action consumer, so it is both a durable architecture rule and an implementation requirement.

decisions.title: Authorize TestEvidence for the 0.7.0 milestone
decisions.statement: 继续按推荐顺序实现 TestEvidence，确保测试报告、文件 hash、环境和 Action 版本约束任务完成。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Implement REQ-TEST-001 under the existing evidence-bound completion ADR before moving to Capsule v2.

triage.rationale: The governing architecture rule already exists in ADR-005; this decision authorizes its implementation.

decisions.title: Authorize Capsule v2 for the 0.7.0 milestone
decisions.statement: 继续实现流式 Capsule v2、TUI 导入预检和 Evidence/Action 重新绑定。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Implement REQ-WORKSPACE-002 under the existing Capsule and portable-first ADRs with compressed chunked v2 transport while preserving v1 imports.

triage.rationale: ADR-002 and ADR-004 already govern portable transfer and Capsule as the continuation unit.

decisions.title: Authorize semantic code intelligence for 0.8.0
decisions.statement: 继续实现 LSP-backed code intelligence 与 portable text/symbol fallback。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Implement REQ-LSP-001 through a language-neutral CodeIntelligencePort, an LSP Action adapter and portable fallback tools shared by TUI and Headless.

triage.rationale: The prior ADR triage classified LSP as a local feature inside the accepted layered architecture.

decisions.title: Authorize fork-bound subagent isolation for 0.9.0
decisions.statement: 继续实现通用 profile 子 Agent 的 fork-bound Action、Workspace generation、Evidence 与取消隔离。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Implement REQ-SUBAGENT-001 under ADR-007 by binding each child invocation to its own Session, Workspace fork generation, Evidence scope and parent cancellation tree.

triage.rationale: Generic subagent profiles are already the accepted architecture; this decision authorizes fork-bound execution implementation.

decisions.title: Synchronize extension manifest with the product version
decisions.statement: Chrome 扩展重载后应显示与 package.json 一致的产品版本，不能继续显示 0.1.0。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Generate extension manifest version from package.json during builds and fail CI when the checked-in manifest drifts.

triage.rationale: This enforces the existing single-product-version rule at the browser packaging boundary.

decisions.title: Authorize Chrome shared composition for 0.10.0
decisions.statement: 继续实现 Chrome 共享 Capability Composition、Remote Action 和 Capsule UI。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Implement REQ-CHROME-001 using the shared workspace capability composition, separate browser ToolPack, Remote Action provider, current TestEvidence and Capsule transfer UI.

triage.rationale: The shared composition and client isolation rules are already accepted in ADR-006.

decisions.title: Enforce Side Panel UI consistency without AGENTS constraints
decisions.statement: 不要把 UI 约束直接写进 AGENTS.md；使用 UI Contract、设置组件、自动检查和需求模板约束后续实现。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Keep AGENTS free of project-specific UI rules, publish a Side Panel UI Contract, migrate settings markup to canonical primitives, add static and Chrome E2E gates, and require UI impact evidence in engineering templates.

triage.rationale: The decision creates a cross-cutting UI presentation contract and an executable enforcement layer without changing AGENTS.

decisions.title: Add a read-only execution debug hub
decisions.statement: Chrome 插件不监听端口；插件把执行事件发送给 tinyai Debug Hub，外部服务通过 cursor 和 SSE 实时拉取。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Implement a normalized outbound execution event pipeline, a read-only authenticated Debug Hub with bounded persistence and cursors, incremental HTTP/SSE access, Chrome settings and end-to-end observability tests.

triage.rationale: The decision creates a cross-surface debug protocol and changes browser transport, host service, settings and security boundaries.

decisions.title: Bound streaming and resident Agent memory
decisions.statement: 浏览器任务已消耗约 11 GB 内存，必须彻底修复 token 级全量快照、全量重渲染和无界缓存。
decisions.normalizedDecision: Replace hot-path full projections with source deltas, bound UI/persistence/log/network/debug/session-residency state, and verify long-task memory stays bounded.

triage.rationale: The incident requires a durable streaming protocol change and bounded-memory rules across Runtime, UI, persistence and host adapters.
